# R包安装与加载

```{r}
package_list <- c("randomForest","ggplot2","pheatmap")
# 判断R包加载是否成功来决定是否安装后再加载
for(p in package_list){
  if(!suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(require(p, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE, warn.conflicts = FALSE)))){
    install.packages(p, repos=site)
    suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(library(p, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE, warn.conflicts = FALSE)))
  }
}
library(randomForest)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(pROC)
library(ggsci)
library(caret)
source("/opt/script/stat_plot_functions.R")
```

# tax_bac_rf

```{bash}
# 读取实验设计、Feature表，并进行数据筛选和交叉筛选
cp ~/koji/16S/result/metadata.tsv metadata_bac.tsv
cp ~/koji/16S/result/07_tax/sum_g.txt sum_g_bac.txt
cp ~/koji/16S/result/taxonomy.txt taxonomy_bac.txt

```

# Materials_bac
```{r}
Group="Materials"
# 读取实验设计、和物种分类文件
design = read.table("metadata_bac.tsv",header = T, row.names = 1, sep = "\t")
# 物种分类文件，由usearch10 -sintax_summary生成，详见扩增子分析流程系列
# 本研究以科水平进行训练，其实各层面都可以，具体那个层面最优，需要逐个测试寻找。推荐纲、科、属；不建议用OTU，差异过大
otu_table =read.table("sum_g_bac.txt",header = T, row.names = 1, sep = "\t")
# 筛选北京样品作为训练集
target_col <- paste0("rf", Group)
design_sub = design[design[[target_col]] == "Train", ]
summary(design_sub)
# 筛选OTU
idx = rownames(design_sub) %in% colnames(otu_table)
design_sub = design_sub[idx,]
otutab_t = as.data.frame(t(otu_table[, rownames(design_sub)]))  
design_sub[[Group]] <- factor(design_sub[[Group]])


## 随机森林分类
set.seed(325)
rf = randomForest(otutab_t, design_sub[[Group]], importance=TRUE, proximity=TRUE, ntree = 1000, classwt = c(DSK  =5, WSK =1, WSM=1))
print(rf)
capture.output(print(rf), file = paste0("rf_", Group, "_summary_bac.txt"))

# Call:
#  randomForest(x = otutab_t, y = design_sub$Location, ntree = 1000,      importance = TRUE, proximity = TRUE) 
#                Type of random forest: classification
#                      Number of trees: 1000
# No. of variables tried at each split: 10
# 
#         OOB estimate of  error rate: 0.94%
# Confusion matrix:
#          Jiangmen Korea Shandong Sichuan class.error
# Jiangmen       38     0        0       0       0.000
# Korea           1    39        0       0       0.025
# Shandong        0     0        8       0       0.000
# Sichuan         0     0        0      20       0.000

## 导出feature重要性

# 根据验证验证，预览和保存feature贡献度

imp= as.data.frame(round(rf$importance,2))
imp = imp[order(imp$MeanDecreaseAccuracy,decreasing = F),]
write.table(imp, file = "tax_imp_bac.txt", sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = T, col.names = T)
# Add family annotation
system("awk 'NR==FNR{a[$7]=$5} NR>FNR{print $0\"\t\"a[$1]}' taxonomy_bac.txt tax_imp_bac.txt | sed '1 s/$/Order/' > tax_imp_order_bac.txt")



## 交叉验证选择Features
n = ncol(otutab_t)-1
myotutab_t= otutab_t[1:n]
set.seed(325)
result= rfcv(myotutab_t, design_sub[[Group]], cv.fold=5, scale = "log", step = 0.9)
# result$n.var
# length(result$n.var)
with(result, plot(n.var, error.cv, log="x", type="o", lwd=2))
result1 = result

error.cv = data.frame(num = result$n.var, error.1 =  result$error.cv)
for (i in 316:(315+4)){
  print(i)
  set.seed(i)
  result= rfcv(myotutab_t, design_sub[[Group]], cv.fold=5, scale = "log", step = 0.9)
  error.cv = cbind(error.cv, result$error.cv)
}

### a1. Cross validation 交叉验证选择Features

# ggplot2 visualize result of cross validation
n.var = error.cv$num
error.cv = error.cv[,2:6]
colnames(error.cv) = paste('err',1:5,sep='.')
err.mean = apply(error.cv,1,mean)
allerr = data.frame(num=n.var,err.mean=err.mean,error.cv)

# number of features selected
# 根据 allerr err.mean 最小值取 num
optimal = 17

write.table(allerr, file =paste0("tax_rfcv_",Group,"_bac.txt", sep=""), sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = T, col.names = T)

p = ggplot() + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.1), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.2), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.3), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.4), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.5), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.mean), colour = 'black') + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = optimal, colour='black', lwd=0.36, linetype="dashed") + 
  #  geom_hline(yintercept = min(allerr$err.mean), colour='black', lwd=0.36, linetype="dashed") + 
  coord_trans(x = "log2") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2, 10, 20, 30, 50, 100, 150, 200)) + # , max(allerr$num)
  labs(title=paste('Training set (n = ', dim(otutab_t)[1],')', sep = ''), 
       x='Number of genus ', y='Cross-validation error rate') + 
  annotate("text", x = optimal, y = max(allerr$err.mean), label=paste("optimal = ", optimal, sep="")) + 
  coord_flip() +
  main_theme 
ggsave(p, file = paste0("tax_rfcv_",Group,"_bac.pdf", sep=""), width = 80, height = 89, unit = 'mm')
p

### a2. Features barplot with taxonomy in Family ggplot2美化feature贡献度
imp = read.table("tax_imp_order_bac.txt", header=T, row.names= 1, sep="\t") 
imp = tail(imp, n = 10)
imp$Genus = factor(rownames(imp), levels = rownames(imp))

p = ggplot(imp, aes(x = Genus, y = MeanDecreaseAccuracy, fill = Order)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + 
  coord_flip() + main_theme
ggsave(paste0("tax_top_feautre_bac_",Group,".pdf", sep=""), p, width=89 * 1.5, height=50 * 1.5, unit='mm')
p

## ROC
## --- 使用 ggplot2 绘制投稿级 ROC 曲线 ---
# 1. 计算所有 Location 的 ROC 对象并存入列表
prob_mat <- rf$votes
actual_label <- design_sub[[Group]]
classes <- levels(actual_label)

roc_list <- list()
for (class_name in classes) {
  roc_list[[class_name]] <- roc(actual_label == class_name, 
                                prob_mat[, class_name], 
                                quiet = TRUE)
}

# 2. 使用 ggroc 转换为 ggplot 对象
# 将列表传给 ggroc，会自动根据列表名生成图例
p <- ggroc(roc_list, legacy.axes = TRUE, size = 1) + # legacy.axes=T 使横轴显示为 1-Specificity
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") + # 绘制对角线
  
  # 3. 美化配色：使用 NPG (Nature Publishing Group) 风格配色
  scale_color_npg(name = Group, 
                  labels = paste(names(roc_list), " (AUC = ", 
                                 sapply(roc_list, function(x) sprintf("%.3f", auc(x))), ")", sep="")) +
  
  # 4. 设置坐标轴和标签
  labs(x = "1 - Specificity (False Positive Rate)",
       y = "Sensitivity (True Positive Rate)",
       title = "ROC Curves for Random Forest Classification") +
  
  # 5. 期刊级主题定制
  theme_bw() + # 白色背景，有边框
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), # 去掉主网格线
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), # 去掉次网格线
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"), # 坐标轴标题
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"), # 坐标轴刻度
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = c(0.75, 0.25), # 图例放在右下角内部
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.5)), # 图例半透明背景
    aspect.ratio = 1 # 保持图形正方形，符合 ROC 规范
  )

# 显示图像
print(p)

# 6. 按照 Food Research International 的投稿要求导出
# 通常要求 TIFF (300-600 DPI) 或 PDF
ggsave(paste0("ROC_Curves_FRI_Submission_",Group,"_bac.pdf", sep=""), p, width = 6, height = 5.5, units = "in", dpi = 600)



## 另一地点独立验证

# 如果第一地点数据量足够大，可以取出1/2到1/3进行同一地点的独立验证。方法相同。
design_test = design[design[[target_col]] == "Test", ]
summary(design_test)
idx = rownames(design_test) %in% colnames(otu_table)
design_test = design_test[idx,]
otu_sub = otu_table[,rownames(design_test)]

# 转置，并添加分组信息
otutab_t = as.data.frame(t(otu_sub))
otutab_t[[Group]] = design[rownames(otutab_t),][[Group]]


# 基于训练集随机森林模型验证

set.seed(325)
otutab.pred = predict(rf, t(otu_sub) )  
pre_tab = table(observed=otutab_t[,Group],
                predicted=otutab.pred) 
pre_tab

capture.output(print(pre_tab), file = paste0("pre_tab_", Group, "_summary_bac.txt"))

#           predicted
# observed   Jiangmen Korea Shandong Sichuan
#   Jiangmen       20     0        0       0
#   Korea           0    22        0       0
#   Shandong        0     0        4       0
#   Sichuan         2     0        0       8


test_real_Group <- as.factor(design_test[[Group]]) 

evaluation <- confusionMatrix(otutab.pred, test_real_Group)

# 4. 打印完整评估结果
print(evaluation)
capture.output(print(evaluation), file = paste0("evaluation_", Group, "_summary_bac.txt"))

# Overall Statistics
#                                           
#                Accuracy : 0.9643          
#                  95% CI : (0.8769, 0.9956)
#     No Information Rate : 0.3929          
#     P-Value [Acc > NIR] : < 2.2e-16       
#                                           
#                   Kappa : 0.9471  

# 可视化验证结果

# 整理样本原始分组和预测分类
predict = data.frame(group = otutab_t[,Group], predicted=otutab.pred)

# 保存预测结果表
write.table("SampleID\t", file=paste0("RF_prediction_binary_tax_", Group, "_bac.txt",sep=""),append = F, quote = F, eol = "", row.names = F, col.names = F)
write.table(predict, file = paste0("RF_prediction_binary_tax_", Group, "_bac.txt"),append = T, quote = F, row.names = T, col.names = T, sep = "\t")
```

# Location_bac
```{r}
Group="Location"
# 读取实验设计、和物种分类文件
design = read.table("metadata_bac.tsv",header = T, row.names = 1, sep = "\t")
# 物种分类文件，由usearch10 -sintax_summary生成，详见扩增子分析流程系列
# 本研究以科水平进行训练，其实各层面都可以，具体那个层面最优，需要逐个测试寻找。推荐纲、科、属；不建议用OTU，差异过大
otu_table =read.table("sum_g_bac.txt",header = T, row.names = 1, sep = "\t")
# 筛选北京样品作为训练集
target_col <- paste0("rf", Group)
design_sub = design[design[[target_col]] == "Train", ]
summary(design_sub)
# 筛选OTU
idx = rownames(design_sub) %in% colnames(otu_table)
design_sub = design_sub[idx,]
otutab_t = as.data.frame(t(otu_table[, rownames(design_sub)]))  
design_sub[[Group]] <- factor(design_sub[[Group]])


## 随机森林分类
set.seed(325)
rf = randomForest(otutab_t, design_sub[[Group]], importance=TRUE, proximity=TRUE, ntree = 1000)
print(rf)
capture.output(print(rf), file = paste0("rf_", Group, "_summary_bac.txt"))

# Call:
#  randomForest(x = otutab_t, y = design_sub$Location, ntree = 1000,      importance = TRUE, proximity = TRUE) 
#                Type of random forest: classification
#                      Number of trees: 1000
# No. of variables tried at each split: 10
# 
#         OOB estimate of  error rate: 0.94%
# Confusion matrix:
#          Jiangmen Korea Shandong Sichuan class.error
# Jiangmen       38     0        0       0       0.000
# Korea           1    39        0       0       0.025
# Shandong        0     0        8       0       0.000
# Sichuan         0     0        0      20       0.000

## 导出feature重要性

# 根据验证验证，预览和保存feature贡献度

imp= as.data.frame(round(rf$importance,2))
imp = imp[order(imp$MeanDecreaseAccuracy,decreasing = F),]
write.table(imp, file = "tax_imp_bac.txt", sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = T, col.names = T)
# Add family annotation
system("awk 'NR==FNR{a[$7]=$5} NR>FNR{print $0\"\t\"a[$1]}' taxonomy_bac.txt tax_imp_bac.txt | sed '1 s/$/Order/' > tax_imp_order_bac.txt")



## 交叉验证选择Features
n = ncol(otutab_t)-1
myotutab_t= otutab_t[1:n]
set.seed(325)
result= rfcv(myotutab_t, design_sub[[Group]], cv.fold=5, scale = "log", step = 0.9)
# result$n.var
# length(result$n.var)
with(result, plot(n.var, error.cv, log="x", type="o", lwd=2))
result1 = result

error.cv = data.frame(num = result$n.var, error.1 =  result$error.cv)
for (i in 316:(315+4)){
  print(i)
  set.seed(i)
  result= rfcv(myotutab_t, design_sub[[Group]], cv.fold=5, scale = "log", step = 0.9)
  error.cv = cbind(error.cv, result$error.cv)
}

### a1. Cross validation 交叉验证选择Features

# ggplot2 visualize result of cross validation
n.var = error.cv$num
error.cv = error.cv[,2:6]
colnames(error.cv) = paste('err',1:5,sep='.')
err.mean = apply(error.cv,1,mean)
allerr = data.frame(num=n.var,err.mean=err.mean,error.cv)

# number of features selected
# 根据 allerr err.mean 最小值取 num
optimal = 61

write.table(allerr, file =paste0("tax_rfcv_",Group,"_bac.txt", sep=""), sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = T, col.names = T)

p = ggplot() + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.1), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.2), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.3), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.4), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.5), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.mean), colour = 'black') + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = optimal, colour='black', lwd=0.36, linetype="dashed") + 
  #  geom_hline(yintercept = min(allerr$err.mean), colour='black', lwd=0.36, linetype="dashed") + 
  coord_trans(x = "log2") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2, 10, 20, 30, 50, 100, 150, 200)) + # , max(allerr$num)
  labs(title=paste('Training set (n = ', dim(otutab_t)[1],')', sep = ''), 
       x='Number of genus ', y='Cross-validation error rate') + 
  annotate("text", x = optimal, y = max(allerr$err.mean), label=paste("optimal = ", optimal, sep="")) + 
  coord_flip() +
  main_theme 
ggsave(p, file = paste0("tax_rfcv_",Group,"_bac.pdf", sep=""), width = 80, height = 89, unit = 'mm')
p

### a2. Features barplot with taxonomy in Family ggplot2美化feature贡献度
imp = read.table("tax_imp_order_bac.txt", header=T, row.names= 1, sep="\t") 
imp = tail(imp, n = 10)
imp$Genus = factor(rownames(imp), levels = rownames(imp))

p = ggplot(imp, aes(x = Genus, y = MeanDecreaseAccuracy, fill = Order)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + 
  coord_flip() + main_theme
ggsave(paste0("tax_top_feautre_bac_",Group,".pdf", sep=""), p, width=89 * 1.5, height=50 * 1.5, unit='mm')
p

## ROC
## --- 使用 ggplot2 绘制投稿级 ROC 曲线 ---
# 1. 计算所有 Location 的 ROC 对象并存入列表
prob_mat <- rf$votes
actual_label <- design_sub[[Group]]
classes <- levels(actual_label)

roc_list <- list()
for (class_name in classes) {
  roc_list[[class_name]] <- roc(actual_label == class_name, 
                                prob_mat[, class_name], 
                                quiet = TRUE)
}

# 2. 使用 ggroc 转换为 ggplot 对象
# 将列表传给 ggroc，会自动根据列表名生成图例
p <- ggroc(roc_list, legacy.axes = TRUE, size = 1) + # legacy.axes=T 使横轴显示为 1-Specificity
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") + # 绘制对角线
  
  # 3. 美化配色：使用 NPG (Nature Publishing Group) 风格配色
  scale_color_npg(name = Group, 
                  labels = paste(names(roc_list), " (AUC = ", 
                                 sapply(roc_list, function(x) sprintf("%.3f", auc(x))), ")", sep="")) +
  
  # 4. 设置坐标轴和标签
  labs(x = "1 - Specificity (False Positive Rate)",
       y = "Sensitivity (True Positive Rate)",
       title = "ROC Curves for Random Forest Classification") +
  
  # 5. 期刊级主题定制
  theme_bw() + # 白色背景，有边框
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), # 去掉主网格线
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), # 去掉次网格线
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"), # 坐标轴标题
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"), # 坐标轴刻度
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = c(0.75, 0.25), # 图例放在右下角内部
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.5)), # 图例半透明背景
    aspect.ratio = 1 # 保持图形正方形，符合 ROC 规范
  )

# 显示图像
print(p)

# 6. 按照 Food Research International 的投稿要求导出
# 通常要求 TIFF (300-600 DPI) 或 PDF
ggsave(paste0("ROC_Curves_FRI_Submission_",Group,"_bac.pdf", sep=""), p, width = 6, height = 5.5, units = "in", dpi = 600)



## 另一地点独立验证

# 如果第一地点数据量足够大，可以取出1/2到1/3进行同一地点的独立验证。方法相同。
design_test = design[design[[target_col]] == "Test", ]
summary(design_test)
idx = rownames(design_test) %in% colnames(otu_table)
design_test = design_test[idx,]
otu_sub = otu_table[,rownames(design_test)]

# 转置，并添加分组信息
otutab_t = as.data.frame(t(otu_sub))
otutab_t[[Group]] = design[rownames(otutab_t),][[Group]]


# 基于训练集随机森林模型验证

set.seed(325)
otutab.pred = predict(rf, t(otu_sub) )  
pre_tab = table(observed=otutab_t[,Group],
                predicted=otutab.pred) 
pre_tab

capture.output(print(pre_tab), file = paste0("pre_tab_", Group, "_summary_bac.txt"))

#           predicted
# observed   Jiangmen Korea Shandong Sichuan
#   Jiangmen       20     0        0       0
#   Korea           0    22        0       0
#   Shandong        0     0        4       0
#   Sichuan         2     0        0       8


test_real_Group <- as.factor(design_test[[Group]]) 

evaluation <- confusionMatrix(otutab.pred, test_real_Group)

# 4. 打印完整评估结果
print(evaluation)
capture.output(print(evaluation), file = paste0("evaluation_", Group, "_summary_bac.txt"))

# Overall Statistics
#                                           
#                Accuracy : 0.9643          
#                  95% CI : (0.8769, 0.9956)
#     No Information Rate : 0.3929          
#     P-Value [Acc > NIR] : < 2.2e-16       
#                                           
#                   Kappa : 0.9471  

# 可视化验证结果

# 整理样本原始分组和预测分类
predict = data.frame(group = otutab_t[,Group], predicted=otutab.pred)

# 保存预测结果表
write.table("SampleID\t", file=paste0("RF_prediction_binary_tax_", Group, "_bac.txt",sep=""),append = F, quote = F, eol = "", row.names = F, col.names = F)
write.table(predict, file = paste0("RF_prediction_binary_tax_", Group, "_bac.txt"),append = T, quote = F, row.names = T, col.names = T, sep = "\t")
```

```{r}
myotutab_t= otutab_t[1:n]
set.seed(325)
result= rfcv(myotutab_t, design_sub[[Group]], cv.fold=5, scale = "log", step = 0.9)
# result$n.var
# length(result$n.var)
with(result, plot(n.var, error.cv, log="x", type="o", lwd=2))
result1 = result

error.cv = data.frame(num = result$n.var, error.1 =  result$error.cv)
for (i in 316:(315+4)){
  print(i)
  set.seed(i)
  result= rfcv(myotutab_t, design_sub[[Group]], cv.fold=5, scale = "log", step = 0.9)
  error.cv = cbind(error.cv, result$error.cv)
}

### a1. Cross validation 交叉验证选择Features

# ggplot2 visualize result of cross validation
n.var = error.cv$num
error.cv = error.cv[,2:6]
colnames(error.cv) = paste('err',1:5,sep='.')
err.mean = apply(error.cv,1,mean)
allerr = data.frame(num=n.var,err.mean=err.mean,error.cv)

# number of features selected
# 根据 allerr err.mean 最小值取 num
optimal = 50

write.table(allerr, file =paste0("tax_rfcv_",Group,"_bac.txt", sep=""), sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = T, col.names = T)

p = ggplot() + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.1), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.2), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.3), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.4), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.5), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.mean), colour = 'black') + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = optimal, colour='black', lwd=0.36, linetype="dashed") + 
  #  geom_hline(yintercept = min(allerr$err.mean), colour='black', lwd=0.36, linetype="dashed") + 
  coord_trans(x = "log2") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2, 10, 20, 30, 50, 100, 150, 200)) + # , max(allerr$num)
  labs(title=paste('Training set (n = ', dim(otutab_t)[1],')', sep = ''), 
       x='Number of genus ', y='Cross-validation error rate') + 
  annotate("text", x = optimal, y = max(allerr$err.mean), label=paste("optimal = ", optimal, sep="")) + 
  coord_flip() +
  main_theme 
ggsave(p, file = paste0("tax_rfcv_",Group,"_bac.pdf", sep=""), width = 80, height = 89, unit = 'mm')
p

## ROC
## --- 使用 ggplot2 绘制投稿级 ROC 曲线 ---
# 1. 计算所有 Location 的 ROC 对象并存入列表
prob_mat <- rf$votes
actual_label <- design_sub[[Group]]
classes <- levels(actual_label)

roc_list <- list()
for (class_name in classes) {
  roc_list[[class_name]] <- roc(actual_label == class_name, 
                                prob_mat[, class_name], 
                                quiet = TRUE)
}

# 2. 使用 ggroc 转换为 ggplot 对象
# 将列表传给 ggroc，会自动根据列表名生成图例
p <- ggroc(roc_list, legacy.axes = TRUE, size = 1) + # legacy.axes=T 使横轴显示为 1-Specificity
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") + # 绘制对角线
  
  # 3. 美化配色：使用 NPG (Nature Publishing Group) 风格配色
  scale_color_npg(name = Group, 
                  labels = paste(names(roc_list), " (AUC = ", 
                                 sapply(roc_list, function(x) sprintf("%.3f", auc(x))), ")", sep="")) +
  
  # 4. 设置坐标轴和标签
  labs(x = "1 - Specificity (False Positive Rate)",
       y = "Sensitivity (True Positive Rate)",
       title = "ROC Curves for Random Forest Classification") +
  
  # 5. 期刊级主题定制
  theme_bw() + # 白色背景，有边框
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), # 去掉主网格线
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), # 去掉次网格线
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"), # 坐标轴标题
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"), # 坐标轴刻度
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = c(0.75, 0.25), # 图例放在右下角内部
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.5)), # 图例半透明背景
    aspect.ratio = 1 # 保持图形正方形，符合 ROC 规范
  )

# 显示图像
print(p)

# 6. 按照 Food Research International 的投稿要求导出
# 通常要求 TIFF (300-600 DPI) 或 PDF
ggsave(paste0("ROC_Curves_FRI_Submission_",Group,"_bac.pdf", sep=""), p, width = 6, height = 5.5, units = "in", dpi = 600)



## 另一地点独立验证

# 如果第一地点数据量足够大，可以取出1/2到1/3进行同一地点的独立验证。方法相同。
design_test = design[design[[target_col]] == "Test", ]
summary(design_test)
idx = rownames(design_test) %in% colnames(otu_table)
design_test = design_test[idx,]
otu_sub = otu_table[,rownames(design_test)]

# 转置，并添加分组信息
otutab_t = as.data.frame(t(otu_sub))
otutab_t[[Group]] = design[rownames(otutab_t),][[Group]]


# 基于训练集随机森林模型验证

set.seed(325)
otutab.pred = predict(rf, t(otu_sub) )  
pre_tab = table(observed=otutab_t[,Group],
                predicted=otutab.pred) 
pre_tab

capture.output(print(pre_tab), file = paste0("pre_tab_", Group, "_summary_bac.txt"))

#           predicted
# observed   Jiangmen Korea Shandong Sichuan
#   Jiangmen       20     0        0       0
#   Korea           0    22        0       0
#   Shandong        0     0        4       0
#   Sichuan         2     0        0       8


test_real_Group <- as.factor(design_test[[Group]]) 

evaluation <- confusionMatrix(otutab.pred, test_real_Group)

# 4. 打印完整评估结果
print(evaluation)
capture.output(print(evaluation), file = paste0("evaluation_", Group, "_summary_bac.txt"))

# Overall Statistics
#                                           
#                Accuracy : 0.9643          
#                  95% CI : (0.8769, 0.9956)
#     No Information Rate : 0.3929          
#     P-Value [Acc > NIR] : < 2.2e-16       
#                                           
#                   Kappa : 0.9471  

# 可视化验证结果

# 整理样本原始分组和预测分类
predict = data.frame(group = otutab_t[,Group], predicted=otutab.pred)

# 保存预测结果表
write.table("SampleID\t", file=paste0("RF_prediction_binary_tax_", Group, "_bac.txt",sep=""),append = F, quote = F, eol = "", row.names = F, col.names = F)
write.table(predict, file = paste0("RF_prediction_binary_tax_", Group, "_bac.txt"),append = T, quote = F, row.names = T, col.names = T, sep = "\t")
```

```{r}
  main_theme
```

```{r}
## ROC
## --- 使用 ggplot2 绘制投稿级 ROC 曲线 ---
# 1. 计算所有 Location 的 ROC 对象并存入列表
prob_mat <- rf$votes
actual_label <- design_sub[[Group]]
classes <- levels(actual_label)

roc_list <- list()
for (class_name in classes) {
  roc_list[[class_name]] <- roc(actual_label == class_name, 
                                prob_mat[, class_name], 
                                quiet = TRUE)
}

# 2. 使用 ggroc 转换为 ggplot 对象
# 将列表传给 ggroc，会自动根据列表名生成图例
p <- ggroc(roc_list, legacy.axes = TRUE, size = 1) + # legacy.axes=T 使横轴显示为 1-Specificity
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") + # 绘制对角线
  
  # 3. 美化配色：使用 NPG (Nature Publishing Group) 风格配色
  scale_color_npg(name = Group, 
                  labels = paste(names(roc_list), " (AUC = ", 
                                 sapply(roc_list, function(x) sprintf("%.3f", auc(x))), ")", sep="")) +
  
  # 4. 设置坐标轴和标签
  labs(x = "1 - Specificity (False Positive Rate)",
       y = "Sensitivity (True Positive Rate)",
       title = "ROC Curves for Random Forest Classification") +
  
  # 5. 期刊级主题定制
  theme_bw() + # 白色背景，有边框
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), # 去掉主网格线
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), # 去掉次网格线
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"), # 坐标轴标题
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"), # 坐标轴刻度
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = c(0.75, 0.25), # 图例放在右下角内部
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.5)), # 图例半透明背景
    aspect.ratio = 1 # 保持图形正方形，符合 ROC 规范
  )

# 显示图像
print(p)

# 6. 按照 Food Research International 的投稿要求导出
# 通常要求 TIFF (300-600 DPI) 或 PDF
ggsave(paste0("ROC_Curves_FRI_Submission_",Group,"_bac.pdf", sep=""), p, width = 6, height = 5.5, units = "in", dpi = 600)



## 另一地点独立验证

# 如果第一地点数据量足够大，可以取出1/2到1/3进行同一地点的独立验证。方法相同。
design_test = design[design[[target_col]] == "Test", ]
summary(design_test)
idx = rownames(design_test) %in% colnames(otu_table)
design_test = design_test[idx,]
otu_sub = otu_table[,rownames(design_test)]

# 转置，并添加分组信息
otutab_t = as.data.frame(t(otu_sub))
otutab_t[[Group]] = design[rownames(otutab_t),][[Group]]


# 基于训练集随机森林模型验证

set.seed(325)
otutab.pred = predict(rf, t(otu_sub) )  
pre_tab = table(observed=otutab_t[,Group],
                predicted=otutab.pred) 
pre_tab

capture.output(print(pre_tab), file = paste0("pre_tab_", Group, "_summary_bac.txt"))

#           predicted
# observed   Jiangmen Korea Shandong Sichuan
#   Jiangmen       20     0        0       0
#   Korea           0    22        0       0
#   Shandong        0     0        4       0
#   Sichuan         2     0        0       8


test_real_Group <- as.factor(design_test[[Group]]) 

evaluation <- confusionMatrix(otutab.pred, test_real_Group)

# 4. 打印完整评估结果
print(evaluation)
capture.output(print(evaluation), file = paste0("evaluation_", Group, "_summary_bac.txt"))

# Overall Statistics
#                                           
#                Accuracy : 0.9643          
#                  95% CI : (0.8769, 0.9956)
#     No Information Rate : 0.3929          
#     P-Value [Acc > NIR] : < 2.2e-16       
#                                           
#                   Kappa : 0.9471  

# 可视化验证结果

# 整理样本原始分组和预测分类
predict = data.frame(group = otutab_t[,Group], predicted=otutab.pred)

# 保存预测结果表
write.table("SampleID\t", file=paste0("RF_prediction_binary_tax_", Group, "_bac.txt",sep=""),append = F, quote = F, eol = "", row.names = F, col.names = F)
write.table(predict, file = paste0("RF_prediction_binary_tax_", Group, "_bac.txt"),append = T, quote = F, row.names = T, col.names = T, sep = "\t")
```

# Process_fun

```{r}
Group="Process"
# 读取实验设计、和物种分类文件
design = read.table("metadata_fun.tsv",header = T, row.names = 1, sep = "\t")
# 物种分类文件，由usearch10 -sintax_summary生成，详见扩增子分析流程系列
# 本研究以科水平进行训练，其实各层面都可以，具体那个层面最优，需要逐个测试寻找。推荐纲、科、属；不建议用OTU，差异过大
otu_table =read.table("sum_g_fun.txt",header = T, row.names = 1, sep = "\t")
# 筛选北京样品作为训练集
target_col <- paste0("rf", Group)
design_sub = design[design[[target_col]] == "Train", ]
summary(design_sub)
# 筛选OTU
idx = rownames(design_sub) %in% colnames(otu_table)
design_sub = design_sub[idx,]
otutab_t = as.data.frame(t(otu_table[, rownames(design_sub)]))  
design_sub[[Group]] <- factor(design_sub[[Group]])


## 随机森林分类
set.seed(325)
rf = randomForest(otutab_t, design_sub[[Group]], importance=TRUE, proximity=TRUE, ntree = 1000, classwt = c(ITS_Koji    =1, ITS_Meju   =50))
print(rf)
capture.output(print(rf), file = paste0("rf_", Group, "_summary_fun.txt"))

# Call:
#  randomForest(x = otutab_t, y = design_sub$Location, ntree = 1000,      importance = TRUE, proximity = TRUE) 
#                Type of random forest: classification
#                      Number of trees: 1000
# No. of variables tried at each split: 10
# 
#         OOB estimate of  error rate: 0.94%
# Confusion matrix:
#          Jiangmen Korea Shandong Sichuan class.error
# Jiangmen       38     0        0       0       0.000
# Korea           1    39        0       0       0.025
# Shandong        0     0        8       0       0.000
# Sichuan         0     0        0      20       0.000

## 导出feature重要性

# 根据验证验证，预览和保存feature贡献度

imp= as.data.frame(round(rf$importance,2))
imp = imp[order(imp$MeanDecreaseAccuracy,decreasing = F),]
write.table(imp, file = "tax_imp_fun.txt", sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = T, col.names = T)
# Add family annotation
system("awk 'NR==FNR{a[$7]=$5} NR>FNR{print $0\"\t\"a[$1]}' taxonomy_fun.txt tax_imp_fun.txt | sed '1 s/$/Order/' > tax_imp_order_fun.txt")



## 交叉验证选择Features
n = ncol(otutab_t)-1
myotutab_t= otutab_t[1:n]
set.seed(325)
result= rfcv(myotutab_t, design_sub[[Group]], cv.fold=5, scale = "log", step = 0.9)
# result$n.var
# length(result$n.var)
with(result, plot(n.var, error.cv, log="x", type="o", lwd=2))
result1 = result

error.cv = data.frame(num = result$n.var, error.1 =  result$error.cv)
for (i in 316:(315+4)){
  print(i)
  set.seed(i)
  result= rfcv(myotutab_t, design_sub[[Group]], cv.fold=5, scale = "log", step = 0.9)
  error.cv = cbind(error.cv, result$error.cv)
}

### a1. Cross validation 交叉验证选择Features

# ggplot2 visualize result of cross validation
n.var = error.cv$num
error.cv = error.cv[,2:6]
colnames(error.cv) = paste('err',1:5,sep='.')
err.mean = apply(error.cv,1,mean)
allerr = data.frame(num=n.var,err.mean=err.mean,error.cv)

# number of features selected
# 根据 allerr err.mean 最小值取 num
optimal = 29

write.table(allerr, file =paste0("tax_rfcv_",Group,"_fun.txt", sep=""), sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = T, col.names = T)

p = ggplot() + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.1), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.2), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.3), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.4), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.5), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.mean), colour = 'black') + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = optimal, colour='black', lwd=0.36, linetype="dashed") + 
  #  geom_hline(yintercept = min(allerr$err.mean), colour='black', lwd=0.36, linetype="dashed") + 
  coord_trans(x = "log2") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2, 10, 20, 30, 50, 100, 150, 200)) + # , max(allerr$num)
  labs(title=paste('Training set (n = ', dim(otutab_t)[1],')', sep = ''), 
       x='Number of genus ', y='Cross-validation error rate') + 
  annotate("text", x = optimal, y = max(allerr$err.mean), label=paste("optimal = ", optimal, sep="")) + 
  coord_flip() +
  main_theme 
ggsave(p, file = paste0("tax_rfcv_",Group,"_fun.pdf", sep=""), width = 80, height = 89, unit = 'mm')
```

```{r}
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), # 去掉主网格线
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), # 去掉次网格线
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"), # 坐标轴标题
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"), # 坐标轴刻度
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = c(0.75, 0.25), # 图例放在右下角内部
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.5)), # 图例半透明背景
    aspect.ratio = 1 # 保持图形正方形，符合 ROC 规范
  )

# 显示图像
print(p)

# 6. 按照 Food Research International 的投稿要求导出
# 通常要求 TIFF (300-600 DPI) 或 PDF
ggsave(paste0("ROC_Curves_FRI_Submission_",Group,"_bac.pdf", sep=""), p, width = 6, height = 5.5, units = "in", dpi = 600)



## 另一地点独立验证

# 如果第一地点数据量足够大，可以取出1/2到1/3进行同一地点的独立验证。方法相同。
design_test = design[design[[target_col]] == "Test", ]
summary(design_test)
idx = rownames(design_test) %in% colnames(otu_table)
design_test = design_test[idx,]
otu_sub = otu_table[,rownames(design_test)]

# 转置，并添加分组信息
otutab_t = as.data.frame(t(otu_sub))
otutab_t[[Group]] = design[rownames(otutab_t),][[Group]]


# 基于训练集随机森林模型验证

set.seed(325)
otutab.pred = predict(rf, t(otu_sub) )  
pre_tab = table(observed=otutab_t[,Group],
                predicted=otutab.pred) 
pre_tab

capture.output(print(pre_tab), file = paste0("pre_tab_", Group, "_summary_bac.txt"))

#           predicted
# observed   Jiangmen Korea Shandong Sichuan
#   Jiangmen       20     0        0       0
#   Korea           0    22        0       0
#   Shandong        0     0        4       0
#   Sichuan         2     0        0       8


test_real_Group <- as.factor(design_test[[Group]]) 

evaluation <- confusionMatrix(otutab.pred, test_real_Group)

# 4. 打印完整评估结果
print(evaluation)
capture.output(print(evaluation), file = paste0("evaluation_", Group, "_summary_bac.txt"))

# Overall Statistics
#                                           
#                Accuracy : 0.9643          
#                  95% CI : (0.8769, 0.9956)
#     No Information Rate : 0.3929          
#     P-Value [Acc > NIR] : < 2.2e-16       
#                                           
#                   Kappa : 0.9471  

# 可视化验证结果

# 整理样本原始分组和预测分类
predict = data.frame(group = otutab_t[,Group], predicted=otutab.pred)

# 保存预测结果表
write.table("SampleID\t", file=paste0("RF_prediction_binary_tax_", Group, "_bac.txt",sep=""),append = F, quote = F, eol = "", row.names = F, col.names = F)
write.table(predict, file = paste0("RF_prediction_binary_tax_", Group, "_bac.txt"),append = T, quote = F, row.names = T, col.names = T, sep = "\t")
```

# Fat_fun

```{r}
Group="Fat"
# 读取实验设计、和物种分类文件
design = read.table("metadata_fun.tsv",header = T, row.names = 1, sep = "\t")
# 物种分类文件，由usearch10 -sintax_summary生成，详见扩增子分析流程系列
# 本研究以科水平进行训练，其实各层面都可以，具体那个层面最优，需要逐个测试寻找。推荐纲、科、属；不建议用OTU，差异过大
otu_table =read.table("sum_g_fun.txt",header = T, row.names = 1, sep = "\t")
# 筛选北京样品作为训练集
target_col <- paste0("rf", Group)
design_sub = design[design[[target_col]] == "Train", ]
summary(design_sub)
# 筛选OTU
idx = rownames(design_sub) %in% colnames(otu_table)
design_sub = design_sub[idx,]
otutab_t = as.data.frame(t(otu_table[, rownames(design_sub)]))  
design_sub[[Group]] <- factor(design_sub[[Group]])


## 随机森林分类
set.seed(325)
rf = randomForest(otutab_t, design_sub[[Group]], importance=TRUE, proximity=TRUE, ntree = 100, classwt = c(Defatted    =10, FullFat  =1))
print(rf)
capture.output(print(rf), file = paste0("rf_", Group, "_summary_fun.txt"))

# Call:
#  randomForest(x = otutab_t, y = design_sub$Location, ntree = 1000,      importance = TRUE, proximity = TRUE) 
#                Type of random forest: classification
#                      Number of trees: 1000
# No. of variables tried at each split: 10
# 
#         OOB estimate of  error rate: 0.94%
# Confusion matrix:
#          Jiangmen Korea Shandong Sichuan class.error
# Jiangmen       38     0        0       0       0.000
# Korea           1    39        0       0       0.025
# Shandong        0     0        8       0       0.000
# Sichuan         0     0        0      20       0.000

## 导出feature重要性

# 根据验证验证，预览和保存feature贡献度

imp= as.data.frame(round(rf$importance,2))
imp = imp[order(imp$MeanDecreaseAccuracy,decreasing = F),]
write.table(imp, file = "tax_imp_fun.txt", sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = T, col.names = T)
# Add family annotation
system("awk 'NR==FNR{a[$7]=$5} NR>FNR{print $0\"\t\"a[$1]}' taxonomy_fun.txt tax_imp_fun.txt | sed '1 s/$/Order/' > tax_imp_order_fun.txt")



## 交叉验证选择Features
n = ncol(otutab_t)-1
myotutab_t= otutab_t[1:n]
set.seed(325)
result= rfcv(myotutab_t, design_sub[[Group]], cv.fold=5, scale = "log", step = 0.9)
# result$n.var
# length(result$n.var)
with(result, plot(n.var, error.cv, log="x", type="o", lwd=2))
result1 = result

error.cv = data.frame(num = result$n.var, error.1 =  result$error.cv)
for (i in 316:(315+4)){
  print(i)
  set.seed(i)
  result= rfcv(myotutab_t, design_sub[[Group]], cv.fold=5, scale = "log", step = 0.9)
  error.cv = cbind(error.cv, result$error.cv)
}

### a1. Cross validation 交叉验证选择Features

# ggplot2 visualize result of cross validation
n.var = error.cv$num
error.cv = error.cv[,2:6]
colnames(error.cv) = paste('err',1:5,sep='.')
err.mean = apply(error.cv,1,mean)
allerr = data.frame(num=n.var,err.mean=err.mean,error.cv)

# number of features selected
# 根据 allerr err.mean 最小值取 num
optimal = 5

write.table(allerr, file =paste0("tax_rfcv_",Group,"_fun.txt", sep=""), sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = T, col.names = T)

p = ggplot() + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.1), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.2), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.3), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.4), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.5), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.mean), colour = 'black') + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = optimal, colour='black', lwd=0.36, linetype="dashed") + 
  #  geom_hline(yintercept = min(allerr$err.mean), colour='black', lwd=0.36, linetype="dashed") + 
  coord_trans(x = "log2") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2, 10, 20, 30, 50, 100, 150, 200)) + # , max(allerr$num)
  labs(title=paste('Training set (n = ', dim(otutab_t)[1],')', sep = ''), 
       x='Number of genus ', y='Cross-validation error rate') + 
  annotate("text", x = optimal, y = max(allerr$err.mean), label=paste("optimal = ", optimal, sep="")) + 
  coord_flip() +
  main_theme 
ggsave(p, file = paste0("tax_rfcv_",Group,"_fun.pdf", sep=""), width = 80, height = 89, unit = 'mm')
p

### a2. Features barplot with taxonomy in Family ggplot2美化feature贡献度

## ROC
## --- 使用 ggplot2 绘制投稿级 ROC 曲线 ---
# 1. 计算所有 Location 的 ROC 对象并存入列表
prob_mat <- rf$votes
actual_label <- design_sub[[Group]]
classes <- levels(actual_label)

roc_list <- list()
for (class_name in classes) {
  roc_list[[class_name]] <- roc(actual_label == class_name, 
                                prob_mat[, class_name], 
                                quiet = TRUE)
}

# 2. 使用 ggroc 转换为 ggplot 对象
# 将列表传给 ggroc，会自动根据列表名生成图例
p <- ggroc(roc_list, legacy.axes = TRUE, size = 1) + # legacy.axes=T 使横轴显示为 1-Specificity
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") + # 绘制对角线
  
  # 3. 美化配色：使用 NPG (Nature Publishing Group) 风格配色
  scale_color_npg(name = Group, 
                  labels = paste(names(roc_list), " (AUC = ", 
                                 sapply(roc_list, function(x) sprintf("%.3f", auc(x))), ")", sep="")) +
  
  # 4. 设置坐标轴和标签
  labs(x = "1 - Specificity (False Positive Rate)",
       y = "Sensitivity (True Positive Rate)",
       title = "ROC Curves for Random Forest Classification") +
  
  # 5. 期刊级主题定制
  theme_bw() + # 白色背景，有边框
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), # 去掉主网格线
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), # 去掉次网格线
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"), # 坐标轴标题
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"), # 坐标轴刻度
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = c(0.75, 0.25), # 图例放在右下角内部
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.5)), # 图例半透明背景
    aspect.ratio = 1 # 保持图形正方形，符合 ROC 规范
  )

# 显示图像
print(p)
```
